**Summary & Next Steps – PeteMart Architecture (Agent 03 architect_agent)**  

---

### 1. Current State (as of the latest artifacts)  

| Deliverable | Status | Comments |
|-------------|--------|----------|
| **FEASIBILITY_ARCHITECTURE.md** | ✅ Generated & approved | Full‑stack design, API‑first, API‑gateway rate‑limiting, CI/CD, testing layers, cost‑scaling model. |
| **FEASIBILITY_ARCHITECTURE.json** | ✅ Generated & approved | Structured metadata, tech‑stack, architecture pattern, POC scope, scaling thresholds. |
| **DIAGRAMS.md** (C4, Container, Data Flow, Deployment) | ✅ Generated | Clear visual contracts for all stakeholders. |
| **POC_SCOPE.md** | ✅ Generated & verified | 8 pilot merchants, ₹0 /month, free‑tier services, explicit out‑of‑scope items (WhatsApp, AI, multi‑store cart). |
| **COST_MODELS.md** | ✅ Generated | Detailed monthly cost breakdown for production (≈ ₹2.5 L/mo at 5 000+ merchants). |
| **COMPLETION_SLIDE.pptx** & **DATA_EXPORT.xlsx** | ✅ Generated | Ready for stakeholder presentation and cost‑model validation. |
| **Guardrail Verification** | ✅ Passed | Multi‑layer testing, API‑gateway rate limiting, dynamic cost scaling, POC‑to‑full‑architecture mapping. |
| **Fixes (F‑001‑F‑003)** | ✅ Verified | All high‑/medium‑severity findings resolved. |

**Overall health:** All mandatory artifacts exist, are version‑controlled, and have passed the formal gate reviews. The project is **awaiting final approval** before moving into detailed implementation.

---

### 2. Key Open Items (not blockers, but worth noting)

| Item | Reason | Recommended Action |
|------|--------|--------------------|
| **WhatsApp Integration** | Deferred from POC scope (F‑002) | Add a dedicated integration ticket; schedule a 2‑week spike to evaluate Twilio/WhatsApp Business API and decide on inclusion in the full build. |
| **AI/ML Component** | Replaced Gemini with Opencode/DeepSeek (F‑001) | Define a clear AI service contract (e.g., recommendation engine, inventory forecast
